_meta.source: Static, redacted page copies of the signed-in chatgpt.com app (tools/capture/signed-in/snapshot.js), loaded from file:// in headless Chromium; the stylesheets and icon sprites are inlined in each copy, fonts and a few images come from OpenAI's asset hosts through a local cache. Nothing was requested from chatgpt.com itself.
_meta.themes: Each copy was captured in the dark theme with the blue accent. Dark states have plain names; light states (`light`, `light-<state>`) were read from the same DOM with every `dark` class removed (on <html> and on each markdown body). Every state records `theme` and `snapshot`.

states.hover: real mouse hover (page.mouse.move), 450ms settle; not measured on the 390 snapshots
states.focus-visible: real keyboard focus (focus, Shift+Tab, Tab) on the element or its first focusable descendant; recorded as skipped where the element cannot take focus
states.other: active / selected / checked / open / typed / enabled / ... are other elements or snapshots captured in that state

_meta.tokens: `vars` lists every var(--x) named in the classes of the element and its first descendants, resolved in that state's theme.
